input.description: List public assets and SEO-related files

content.text: SEO metadata is split across the root layout and the home page, and the OG image in `public` is not referenced. I’ll put that metadata in one module and point Open Graph and Twitter at `friction-fixer-og.jpg`.

SEO metadata now lives in `web/src/lib/seo.ts`. The root layout and the home page import `rootMetadata` and `homeMetadata` from there.

Both Open Graph and Twitter cards point at `/friction-fixer-og.jpg` (1200×640), so the image in `web/public` is the one shared previews use.
